battle.name: 杜伏威滅宋顥之戰
battle.brief: 大業九年（613）冬，江都留守府遣校尉宋顥將兵討伐屯兵六合的杜伏威。義軍佯裝歸順，把隋軍引入六合一帶的蘆葦蕩，待順風一起縱火焚燒，隋軍步騎燒死者幾盡，宋顥兵敗殞命。此役無攻城、無砲擊，卡面的投石機這類固定拋石器並不在現場，決定戰局的只有火與風。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 大業九年（613）秋冬，淮南的對抗是隋朝江都留守府與杜伏威起義軍之間的一場不對稱較量。隋方是江都留守府體系：隋煬帝於同年七月幸江都，命越王楊侗與光祿大夫段達、太府卿元文都、檢校民部尚書韋津、右武衛將軍皇甫天逸、右司郎盧楚等總領留後事，郡縣的常備武力則是江都郡校尉所領的宿衛精兵與郡兵；府兵舊制早已崩解，各城所倚靠的是留京禁軍、郡兵與臨時徵發的鄉里武裝。起義方是杜伏威與輔公祏在濟北長白山聚眾起事、轉戰江淮的隊伍：此時已屯兵六合，兵眾達數萬之眾，輔公祏以長史身分分掌軍政，部眾多為山東、淮南的鄉里壯丁、散兵與歸附的小盜，號令與糧秣靠首領的個人威望與就地徵集維持，尚未取得正式建制。雙方指揮系統的差別很清楚：隋軍有文書、有印信、有明確的將官序列，卻遠在北方，糧秣靠運河輸送；義軍沒有官爵，卻熟悉本地道路、水網與可用的柴草，一旦主力離開城防就沒有退路。
countriesEn: The contest in the Huai region in the winter of the ninth year of Daye (613) was an unequal one between the Jiangdu resident office of the Sui and the rebel force of Du Fuwei. On the Sui side stood the Jiangdu resident system: in the seventh month of that year the Yangdi emperor travelled to Jiangdu and ordered the Prince of Yue, Yang Tong, together with the Grand Master of Ceremonies Duan Da, the Minister of the Palace Yuan Wendu, the Assistant Minister of Revenue Wei Jin, the Right Wuwei General Huangfu Tianyi, the Right Assistant Lang Lu Chu and others to take charge of the affairs left behind at the capital. The standing strength of the prefectures and counties was the picked guard of the interior under a commandant such as Song Hao of Jiangdu, together with county troops; the old fubing system had long since fallen apart, and what each walled town relied on was the palace guard, the county levies and armed villagers mustered on the spot. The other side was the force that Du Fuwei and Fu Gongshi had raised at Changbai Mountain in northern Jizhou and carried into the Huai region: it was now stationed at Liuhe with a strength counted in tens of thousands, with Fu Gongshi as zhangshi administering military and civil affairs, its ranks made up largely of village youths, scattered soldiers and small bands that had attached themselves from Shandong and the Huai region. Orders and supplies rested on the personal authority of the leader and on what could be levied locally; the rebels held no official commission of any kind. The difference between the two command systems is clear. The Sui had documents, seals and a regular sequence of officers, but lay far to the north and drew its grain by canal. The rebels had neither titles nor rank, yet knew the local roads, the water network and the usable brushwood, and once their main body left the shelter of the walls they had nowhere to fall back on.
people: 核心人物是杜伏威（583－623），名堯，字伏威，齊州章丘人，少時落拓不事生業，與輔公祏結為生死之交，大業九年在長白山起事後轉戰江淮，屯兵六合，自此成為江淮義軍的實際統帥。本役的關鍵決策完全出自他手：以詐降誘使隋軍深入、預選蘆葦蕩為埋伏地、待順風一起即縱火焚燒、再以數百騎追擊潰兵，都是這一套打法的組成部分。輔公祏是杜伏威的結義兄弟與長史，替他分掌軍政與後方。隋方主角是江都郡校尉宋顥，奉留守之命將兵討伐，中伏兵敗；史籍對他的下落有兩種記載，一說他即死於葦蕩火中，一說他負傷奔出、被義軍數百騎追上而殞於途中。命令的上游是越王楊侗，他以江都留守的身分總領留後事，也是遣宋顥出兵的決策者；同在江都的段達、元文都、韋津、皇甫天逸、盧楚等分掌留府各曹與禁衛。煬帝本人當時就在江都，遙控前線的每一道詔令。先前奉詔討伐的宿衛精兵八千由光祿大夫陳稜帶領，往返於淮南與江北，與義軍互有勝負；這支部隊的背景說明隋朝在江淮並非無兵可用，只是每一次用兵都受制於距離與糧秣。
peopleEn: The central figure is Du Fuwei (583-623), personal name Yao, courtesy name Fuwei, a native of Zhangqiu in Qizhou, who as a young man was idle and refused to make a living, and who swore the oath of life and death with Fu Gongshi; after raising his revolt at Changbai Mountain in the ninth year of Daye he campaigned into the Huai region and stationed himself at Liuhe, and from that point he was the actual commander of the rebel forces in the Huai. Every decisive decision in this engagement was his own: the feigned submission that drew the Sui troops deep inland, the marsh chosen in advance as the place of ambush, the firing of the reeds the moment the wind turned favourable, and the pursuit of the broken troops with several hundred riders, are all parts of one method. Fu Gongshi was Du Fuwei's sworn brother and zhangshi, administering the military and civil affairs and the rear for him. The principal Sui figure is Song Hao, commandant of Jiangdu prefecture, who was sent with troops by the resident office to put down the revolt and was caught in the ambush; the records differ over his fate, one version holding that he died in the burning reeds on the spot, another that he fled wounded and was run down by several hundred of the rebel riders. The authority above him was the Prince of Yue, Yang Tong, who as resident at Jiangdu took charge of all that was left behind and was the man who decided to send Song Hao out; sharing the resident office with him were Duan Da, Yuan Wendu, Wei Jin, Huangfu Tianyi and Lu Chu, who between them held the various departments and the guard. The Yangdi emperor was himself then at Jiangdu and directed every dispatch sent to the front from there. The picked guard of eight thousand that had already been sent out under the Grand Master of Ceremonies Chen Leng moved back and forth between the north bank of the Yangtze and the Huai, winning and losing in turn against the rebels; the background of that force shows that the Sui was not without soldiers in the Huai, only that every operation it mounted was constrained by distance and by supply.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是投石機（Onager），卡上把它的年代定在公元前250年前後，屬羅馬共和末期出現的扭力式拋石機：靠絞盤把蓄力轉為拋射，一發可把數十公斤的石塊送到遠方，是羅馬圍城戰的標準攻城器械。這場戰役裡沒有投石機，也沒有任何攻城器械：杜伏威的部眾與江都留守軍都是在開闊的江北水鄉、蘆葦蕩與田隴之間打的野戰，兩軍都沒有可以擺開的攻城器與守城器。真正決定勝負的裝備有兩套。一是隋軍的裝備體系，宿衛精兵著明光鎧甲、配長槊與弓箭弩，步卒有木製大盾與環首刀，郡兵則多為鄉里裝備；江都水軍另有樓船與運輸船。二是義軍的裝備，多為削尖標槍、竹木弓箭、環首刀與短戟，防護靠藤牌與皮甲，騎兵數目有限，多是後來從隋軍與地方徵集的軍馬，馬匹總數遠不足以形成衝鋒集群，本役投入追擊的數百騎已是義軍所能聚集的極限。改變戰局的是最簡單的器材：乾枯的蘆葦、收集的柴薪與火，加上對風向的判斷。這些東西在隋軍的裝備表上不列條目，卻比任何攻城器械都更致命——若要為它們找一件對照物，卡面的羅馬投石機恰好說明差別：拋石器需要基座、絞盤與備用的石彈，必須先有城牆才談得上用；而義軍在葦蕩裡用的，是一場不需要攻城器械的攻擊。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the onager, dated on the card to around 250 BC, a torsion-powered stone thrower that appeared in the late Roman Republic: it converts stored power through a winch into a throw and can send a stone of several dozen kilograms to a considerable distance, and it was the standard siege engine of the Roman wars against walls. There was no onager in this campaign, and there were no siege engines at all: Du Fuwei's men and the garrison of Jiangdu fought an open-field action in the watery country north of the Yangtze, among reed beds and paddy fields, and neither side had anything that could be set up as a besieging or a defending engine. The equipment that really decided the day was of two kinds. The first was the Sui system: the picked guard wore gleaming plate armour and carried long lances, bows and crossbows, the infantry had large wooden shields and ring-pommel sabres, while the county levies were mostly equipped as village militia; the Jiangdu flotilla had war-junks and transport boats besides. The second was the rebel equipment: sharpened javelins, bamboo and wooden bows, ring-pommel sabres and short halberds, with rattan shields and hide armour for protection, and with few horses, taken mostly from the Sui and from local levies, far too few to form a charging mass, so that the several hundred riders committed to the pursuit were the very limit the rebel army could gather. What overturned the battle was the simplest of materiel: dry reeds, gathered brushwood and fire, together with a reading of the wind. None of it appeared on the Sui inventory, and yet it killed far more than any siege engine would have. If a comparison is wanted, the Roman onager on the card states the difference exactly: a stone thrower needs a base, a winch and a supply of shot, and can only be brought into play once there is a wall to throw at, whereas what Du Fuwei used in the reed bed was an attack that required no siege engine at all.
tactics: 這一役的戰術骨架是示弱、設伏、火攻、追擊四步。第一步是詐降：義軍派出使者向宋顥表示願意歸順，把一支看上去已經潰散或願意受編的隊伍送到隋軍面前，使對方相信不必打硬仗，於是離開城防、拖著主力深入江北水鄉。第二步是設伏：埋伏點選在蘆葦蕩，這種地形在江淮秋冬枯水期水淺而蘆葦高密，視線被遮斷，隊列一旦進入就難以展開、難以回旋，隋軍的長槊密集與騎兵衝撞在此完全施展不開，龐大的編制反而成了累贅。第三步是火攻：義軍等到順風時機一齊縱火，火勢借風在枯蘆上迅速蔓延，隋軍在無遮蔽的葦蕩中四散奔逃，鎧甲在火裏難以卸除。第四步是追擊：火起之後義軍以數百騎追擊潰散的步騎，把殘餘兵力逐出戰場。全程義軍沒有正面硬碰隋軍主力，也沒有爭奪城池與渡口，打的是一場以弱勝強、只求一戰而毀敵一部的遭遇戰，靠的是對地形與風候的熟悉、對隋軍輕敵的利用，以及一支部隊在不利地形中仍然保持的齊整。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this engagement has four steps: showing weakness, laying the ambush, the fire, and the pursuit. The first was the feigned submission: the rebels sent envoys to Song Hao offering to come over, and paraded a body that looked either already broken or willing to be enrolled, so that the Sui command believed it would not have to fight hard; it therefore left the shelter of the walls and dragged its main force deep into the watery country north of the Yangtze. The second was the ambush, whose ground was a reed bed. In the dry season of winter and autumn in the Huai region the water runs shallow while the reeds stand high and dense, sight is broken off, and a formation that enters cannot deploy or turn about; the Sui strength in close lance order and in mounted charge could not be brought to bear there at all, and the sheer size of its formation became a liability instead of an asset. The third was the fire: the rebels waited for the wind to turn favourable and then fired everything at once, and the flames ran through the dry reeds with the wind; the Sui troops scattered in an open reed bed with no cover, and armour could not be stripped off in the burning grass. The fourth was the pursuit: once the fire was up, several hundred rebel riders ran down the broken infantry and cavalry and drove what was left of them off the field. Throughout, the rebels never met the Sui main body head on and never fought for a walled town or a ferry crossing; this was an encounter fought out of weakness with a single aim of destroying one detached force, and it rested on a knowledge of the ground and the weather, on the taking advantage of Sui contempt, and on a formation that stayed in order even in ground unfavourable to it.
data: 可考與不可考的數字需要分開說。大業九年（613）七月，隋煬帝幸江都，命越王侗與光祿大夫段達、太府卿元文都、檢校民部尚書韋津、右武衛將軍皇甫天逸、右司郎盧楚等總留後事，這是江都留守府的建置之始；同年《資治通鑑》記「杜伏威屯六合，眾各數萬」，這是義軍兵力的唯一量級記載，只能視為約數而非確數。通鑑又記「帝遣光祕大夫陳稜將宿衛精兵八千討之，往往克捷」，八千是本役前後唯一見於史籍的精確兵數，屬隋方中央宿衛的規模。宋顥所領部眾的數目、雙方接戰的距離與歷時，史無記載；新唐書只用「步騎燒死幾盡」形容損失，屬定性描述，不能換算成具體人數。年月方面，史料只繫於大業九年，沒有保留確切月日；依編年次第——七月煬帝幸江都、留守府成立，同年陳稜率宿衛精兵討伐「往往克捷」，義軍此時已屯六合——推知本役當在大業九年秋冬之交，本表按十月記載。地理上，六合在今南京西北，是唐時揚州與江都之間的江淮要地，往北有大道通向淮北重鎮，往南臨長江與運河水道，隋軍由揚州出兵北上的話，走水路可直抵江岸，走陸路則要橫渡一片水網。義寧元年（617）正月杜伏威「乘勝破高郵，引兵據歷陽，自稱總管，以輔公祏為長史」，並「常選取死之士五千人，謂之上募」，那是後一年的制度，本役時尚未形成，不能倒推。
dataEn: Figures that can be checked and figures that cannot have to be kept apart. In the seventh month of the ninth year of Daye (613) the Yangdi emperor travelled to Jiangdu and appointed the Prince of Yue Yang Tong together with the Grand Master of Ceremonies Duan Da, the Minister of the Palace Yuan Wendu, the Assistant Minister of Revenue Wei Jin, the Right Wuwei General Huangfu Tianyi and the Right Assistant Lang Lu Chu to take charge of what was left behind; this was the founding of the Jiangdu resident office. In the same year the Comprehensive Mirror records that Du Fuwei was stationed at Liuhe with troops counted in tens of thousands; that is the only statement of the rebel strength and can be read only as an order of magnitude, not a count. The same work records that the emperor sent the Grand Master of Ceremonies Chen Leng with eight thousand of the picked guard of the interior to attack him, and that this usually succeeded. Eight thousand is the only exact figure from the sources for the troops involved in this period, and it is the scale of the Sui palace guard. The number of men under Song Hao, the distance over which the two sides met and the length of the engagement are not recorded; the New Book of Tang describes the losses only as the foot and horse being burnt almost to the last, which is a qualitative phrase and cannot be converted into a headcount. As to date, the sources attach the affair only to the ninth year of Daye and preserve no exact month or day; from the sequence of the annals, with the emperor reaching Jiangdu and the resident office being set up in the seventh month, and Chen Leng leading the picked guard out in the same year with results usually favourable, the engagement must have fallen at the turn of autumn and winter in the ninth year of Daye, and this table records it in the tenth month. As to geography, Liuhe lies to the north-west of present-day Nanjing and is a key point of the Huai region between Yangzhou and Jiangdu in Tang times; to the north a great road runs to the strongholds of the northern Huai, while to the south lie the Yangtze and the canal waterway. A Sui army marching north from Yangzhou could go by water straight to the river bank, or by land only by fording a web of channels. In the first month of the second year of Yining (617) Du Fuwei, having broken Gaoyou, moved his troops to Liyang, proclaimed himself zongguan and made Fu Gongshi his zhangshi, and he habitually picked out five thousand men who would give their lives and called them the shangmu; that was an institution of the following year, and it did not yet exist in this engagement, so it cannot be read back into it.
cause: 打起來的直接原因，是隋廷要保住江都，而杜伏威的隊伍已經壓在江都的北面。隋朝連年征高句麗，府庫空虛、民力疲敝，役夫與逃戶大批流入山東、江淮的盜匪群體；大業九年七月煬帝南幸江都，把朝廷的後半部搬到運河盡頭，江都留守府同時成了前線的指揮部與後方的總樞紐。杜伏威自大業九年秋在齊州長白山起事，到同年冬已屯兵六合，眾各數萬，江北的鄉里與小盜紛紛歸附，這在留守府眼中已不是一伙可以派幾百人剿掉的盜賊，而是威脅到揚州城防與運河糧道的一支軍隊，於是遣郡校尉宋顥將兵討之。對義軍一方，消滅隋朝在江北的一支分遣部隊同樣是急務：江都的宿衛精兵一旦被抽調或覆滅，留守府對江北的控制就只剩空名，而義軍要做的正是在淮南建立一個能自給自足的根據地，之後才有條件向歷陽、丹陽一線擴張。雙方的目標在這一役交叉到了一起，衝突因此不可避免。
causeEn: The immediate reason for the fighting was that the Sui court had to hold Jiangdu, and Du Fuwei's force was already pressing against it from the north. The Sui had campaigned against Goguryeo year after year, the treasury was empty and the manpower of the people exhausted, and levies and runaways had poured into the bands of bandits in Shandong and the Huai region. In the seventh month of the ninth year of Daye the Yangdi emperor travelled south to Jiangdu and moved the rear half of his court to the end of the canal, so that the Jiangdu resident office became at once the command post on the front and the hub of the rear. Du Fuwei had risen at Changbai Mountain in Qizhou in the autumn of that year, and by the winter he was stationed at Liuhe with troops counted in tens of thousands, while the villages of the north bank and the small bands there attached themselves to him. To the resident office this was no longer a company of bandits that could be chased away by a few hundred men; it was an army that threatened the defences of Yangzhou and the grain road of the canal, and so the prefectural commandant Song Hao was sent out with troops. For the rebels, destroying a detached Sui force north of the river was just as urgent: once the picked guard of Jiangdu had been drawn off or destroyed, the resident office's control north of the river would be an empty title, and what the rebels needed was a self-supporting base in the Huai region, the necessary precondition for any further expansion toward Liyang and Danyang. The objectives of the two sides met in this one engagement, and the clash was unavoidable.
impact: 這一役的結果是江都留守府在江淮正面第一次碰壁，隋廷在江北的軍事信用由此轉為負數。宋顥所部覆沒，宿衛精兵再出一支便折損一部，揚州城對六合、歷陽方向的警戒被迫收緊，隋朝原打算靠郡兵與鄉兵層層抵抗的方案，被義軍用一次火攻打了個對折。對杜伏威而言，勝利的意義遠大於一場普通伏擊：這是他第一次在江北水鄉正面擊敗隋朝留守府的正規部隊，此後得以在江淮站穩，兩年後在義寧元年（617）再敗光祿大夫陳稜、破高郵、進據歷陽、自稱總管，兵鋒自六合推向江都城下。就長江下游的整體格局而言，這一役使隋朝在江南的防衛體系裂開一道口子，義軍得以截斷江北的鄉里徵發與運河沿線的郡縣聯防；隋末群雄中，李子通據海陵、左才相部在淮北往來拉鋸，杜伏威屯六合，江淮的真空局面就此固化。杜伏威其後能以江淮的兵力、糧秣與船隻為資本，在唐初成為平定江南的一支決定性力量，源頭正起於這場以火取勝的遭遇戰。
impactEn: The result of this engagement was that the Jiangdu resident office met its first reverse in the Huai, and the military credit of the Sui court north of the river turned into a liability. Song Hao's force was destroyed; every detachment of the picked guard that was sent out lost a part of itself; the watch of Yangzhou toward Liuhe and Liyang had to be drawn in tight; and the Sui plan of resisting in layers with county troops and village levies was cut in half by a single attack with fire. For Du Fuwei the meaning of the victory was far greater than that of an ordinary ambush: it was the first time he defeated in open fighting in the watery country north of the river a regular force of the Sui resident office, and it allowed him to take root in the Huai region; two years later, in the first year of Yining (617), he defeated the Grand Master of Ceremonies Chen Leng again, broke Gaoyou, advanced to Liyang and proclaimed himself zongguan, and the line of his advance moved from Liuhe towards the walls of Jiangdu. For the wider structure of the lower Yangtze this engagement opened a gap in the Sui defence system in the south: the rebels were able to cut the levy of the villages north of the river and the linked defence of the prefectures along the canal. Among the contenders of the late Sui, Li Zitong held Hailing, the bands of Zuo Caixiang ranged across the northern Huai, and Du Fuwei sat at Liuhe, and the vacuum in the Huai region was fixed from then on. The troops, the grain and the boats of the Huai were the capital on which Du Fuwei later drew when he became one of the decisive forces in the Tang's settlement of the south, and the source of that capital was this fire-lit encounter.
result: 結局是宋顥部的覆滅與義軍在江淮的地位鞏固。史籍於宋顥的下場有兩種記載：一說他中伏後即死於蘆葦蕩的火中，一說他負傷奔出、被杜伏威的數百騎追上而殞於途中；兩說都肯定同一件事——這支隋軍在火攻中喪失了幾乎全部的步騎，隨行的郡兵與器械一併丟在江北。義軍沒有乘勢攻取揚州，也沒有與隋軍在城外反覆纏鬥，火滅即收，兵回六合，按兵再圖。這正是杜伏威一貫的作風：不與隋軍主力硬拼，只找分遣出城的部隊吃掉，用戰果換地盤，再以地盤換實力。從全局看，這一役是隋末江淮戰局的一個轉折點：義軍第一次證明自己能在隋朝控制最緊、地形最不利於己的南線站住腳步，而隋朝第一次嘗到留守軍在外線被全殲的滋味。此後隋廷在江南再無足夠的機動兵可用，江都實際上成了一座孤城，四年後江都陷落、隋朝覆亡的結局已在此時埋下伏線。
resultEn: The outcome was the destruction of Song Hao's command and the consolidation of the rebels' position in the Huai. The sources offer two accounts of Song Hao's end: one has him killed where he fell, in the burning reeds; the other has him wounded and fleeing, run down by the several hundred riders of Du Fuwei; both agree on the one thing that matters, that this Sui force lost almost all of its foot and horse in the fire, while the county levies that marched with it and its equipment were abandoned in the north bank country. The rebels did not press on to take Yangzhou and did not grind away at the Sui in a prolonged battle outside the walls; once the fire was out they pulled back, returned to Liuhe and sat down to plan the next move. This was Du Fuwei's established way: never to trade blows with the main body of the Sui army, but to find the detachments sent out of the cities and destroy them, trading a victory for ground and then ground for strength. Seen in the wider view, this engagement was a turning point in the fighting in the Huai region in the last years of the Sui. For the first time the rebels proved that they could hold their ground on the southern front, where Sui control was tightest and the ground least favourable to them; and for the first time the Sui tasted what it meant to have a resident army annihilated on an outer line. After this the Sui court had no mobile troops to spare in the south, and Jiangdu in practice became an isolated city; the fall of Jiangdu four years later and the end of the Sui were already prepared here.
